children.text: Thought it is already the XXI century, the Mass Media isn't very popular in Walrusland. The cities get news from messengers who can only travel along roads. The network of roads in Walrusland is built so that it is possible to get to any city from any other one in exactly one way, and the roads' lengths are equal.
